name: jdwp-desktop-root
description: Run OS-specific app from app/windows, app/macos, or app/linux

scripts.windows: npm --prefix app/windows install && npm --prefix app/windows run electron:dev
scripts.macos: npm --prefix app/macos install && npm --prefix app/macos run electron:dev
scripts.linux: npm --prefix app/linux install && npm --prefix app/linux run electron:dev
